caption: The drawing depicts a teapot rendered in shades of gray pencil or ink on a beige background. The teapot has a rounded, bulbous body with petal-like segments at its base, a short pedestal foot, and a squared, angular handle attached to the left side with dark bands. There is a long, curved spout on the right that rises and curves outwards at the tip. The lid of the teapot is domed and topped with a decorative knob, featuring a floral or ornamental pattern that is echoed on two horizontal bands—one near the base and another just below the lid. The midsection of the teapot is adorned with a horizontal frieze featuring grapevine motifs including leaves and grape clusters. A thin rectangular border surrounds the teapot image, and in the bottom right corner, there is a smaller, simplified line sketch of the same teapot design with the name "M. Fenga" written beneath it. The entire composition appears monochromatic, with shading to indicate reflective metallic surfaces and dimensionality.
title: Silver Teapot
